recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It aligns the FHIR-36248 boundary with later approved Transport.reason and Encounter.businessStatus semantics without reintroducing the superseded business-status Transport.reason element; any direct historical EncounterHistory link should be a separate OO/PA decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive-with-Modification OO issue for R5 asking Transport to describe boundaries between physical movement and independent business-state changes such as patient class or level of care; the final application added boundary prose and a reason element, and later PA discussion removed the need for a direct EncounterHistory link.
initial_application: Commit 3afd6e72b6 added the requested Transport boundary paragraph and a Transport.reason CodeableConcept for business status, followed by ca6f36eb21 sequencing cleanup. Later FHIR-39141 commits replaced/remodeled Transport.reason as the current CodeableReference for why transport is needed, leaving the old boundary paragraph stale.
additional_context: FHIR-39141 and FHIR-40310 establish current Transport.reason as repeatable CodeableReference content for why transport is needed. FHIR-47297 later added Encounter.businessStatus for current encounter business statuses and directs historical business statuses to EncounterHistory. Confluence minutes support the original boundary discussion and the later decision not to add a direct Transport-to-EncounterHistory link at that time.
reconciliation: Changed source/transport/transport-introduction.xml to say Transport records the physical movement, encounter business status can change with or without movement, Encounter.businessStatus represents current encounter business status, and Transport.reason records why the transport is needed.
source_changes: source/transport/transport-introduction.xml: clarified Boundaries and Relationships text to point current encounter business status to Encounter.businessStatus and reserve Transport.reason for why transport is needed.

related_jiras.note: Replaced Transport.reasonCode/reasonReference with repeatable Transport.reason CodeableReference and removed the seed application's temporary business-status reason duplicate.
Confirmed Transport.reason should keep its name after reasonCode removal and corrected stale Transport.reason prose; already represented on the combined branch.
Added Encounter.businessStatus for current encounter business statuses, providing the current source target for patient class/level-of-care status guidance.
